title: Gate decision
description: One record per file: gates/decisions/<id>.yaml, never edited, deleted, or renamed once the base holds it. A change to a gate's code, its fixtures or their data, or an exemption it reads changes the gate's fingerprint, and the guard gate fails until a gate decision names the gate and accepts the new fingerprint. A record says why. A concept a record accepts can leave kernel/domains.yaml only through a later record's `retires`. Gate decisions are about the tooling, so they don't go to the working group.

question.description: What the change answers, as one question.

rationale.description: Why the change makes no gate weaker, or why a gate is relaxed and what covers what it no longer checks.

accepts.description: Each gate the record accepts, with the fingerprint `npm run gates -- fingerprints` prints for it.

concepts.description: The concepts of kernel/domains.yaml the record accepts.

retires_gates.description: Gates the record removes, each with why. An earlier record that accepts a retired gate stays as it was written, since records are append-only.

retires.description: Concepts the record removes from the model, each with why; a gate that reports a concept unused is not a reason on its own.
